messages:
derek: RFC follow-up: proposal to split compatibility responsibilities so owners are explicit. eng-platform keeps API-facing transforms and SDK helpers; eng-infra owns any in-path adapters and sidecars. Need a canary/playbook.

mei: sounds reasonable. expectation: platform changes should be non-disruptive and testable in shadow mode. infra changes must include perf budgets.

arnold: who authorizes emergency patches? suggest on-call infra for runtime shims, platform PM for API shims. document in runbook.

sre-bot: note: add monitoring tag shim_owner and shim_mode to request logs for correlation.

derek: canary steps I propose: 1) header X-RW-Shim: owner/version 2) shadow for 24-72h 3) metric check gate (errors, p95, fallback) 4) 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m evaluation windows.

mei: metric gates: +0.5% errors OR +100ms p95 triggers automatic rollback. also add functional assertions against recorded request corpus.

ar­nold: add checklist item: publish tiny JSON contract plus backward test vectors in mono-repo so SDKs and infra can run parity checks in CI.

compliance: ensure headers don't contain tenant PII; if any tenant identifiers are present they must be hashed before sending to third-party logs.

derek: I'll update RFC and draft a short runbook PR. owners: platform = mei, infra = arnold, SRE = oncall. will ping for review by EOD. :thumbsup:
